description:
Make a GitHub-flavoured Markdown table from CSV, TSV, a JSON array (of objects or of arrays), an existing Markdown table (to re-align / re-pad it) or a "rows" array. Per-column alignment (left, center, right), columns padded to line up (optional), pipes escaped as \| and line breaks as
. CSV delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab) is detected from the first line. Give "text", a file "path" or "rows". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/markdown-table/

align.description: Column alignment: one value for all columns or one per column. Default: keep a Markdown input's alignment, else none.

format.description: Input format; "auto" detects Markdown, then JSON, then CSV/TSV.

header.description: First row is the header. When false, "Column 1", "Column 2"… headers are added.

output.description: Optional: also write the result to this file path (or folder ending in "/"). The result text is then left out of the reply. Results over 1,000,000 characters are always written to a file.

path.description: Or: a path to a CSV/TSV/JSON/Markdown file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

pretty.description: Pad cells so the columns line up (default true).

rows.description: Or: the table as an array of rows (first row = header unless header is false).

text.description: The CSV / TSV / JSON / Markdown table as inline text.

name: markdown_table
title: Markdown table
